title: Rule Pack body
description: WAF/WARA/APRL-style checks applied to estate nodes by the Quality Checks module.

items.description: One rule. RuleSpec defaults every field (id->'rule', severity->medium) and uses extra='ignore' for forward-compat (quality_checks/module.py:108,112,118-127), so no field is required; a rule without a supported predicate is valid content — it yields a fail-closed unsupported/unevaluable FAILURE (quality_checks/module.py:146-155).

id.description: Stable rule id — carried into Finding provenance. RuleSpec types id:str (default 'rule'), so a supplied id must be a non-null string.

resourceType.description: Optional Azure resource type filter (RuleSpec resourceType:str|None); null/absent => rule applies to every node (quality_checks/module.py:141-142).

requiredTag.description: Optional supported predicate (RuleSpec requiredTag:str|None): tag that must be present on the node (quality_checks/module.py:108,146-148).

severity.description: null is normalized to medium (quality_checks/module.py:_coerce_severity, :80-82); a NON-null value must be a valid Severity.

description.description: Intentionally NON-nullable to match RuleSpec.description:str='' — _normalize_rule does NOT pre-coerce description, so a null value raises ValidationError and the rule is dropped at runtime (quality_checks/module.py:166-190).
